@graph.headline: Testing Now Open: GL.iNet Cross-Model Backup & Restore Utility
@graph.description: Testing is now open for the GL.iNet Cross-Model Backup & Restore Utility, a LuCI and CLI tool for safer backup, migration, restore, and recovery across GL.iNet routers and OpenWrt generations.

mainEntity.name: What is the GL.iNet Cross-Model Backup & Restore Utility?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is an open-source LuCI application and CLI for creating, inspecting, validating, migrating, and restoring GL.iNet/OpenWrt router configuration locally or against another router over SSH.

mainEntity.name: Can I restore a backup to a different GL.iNet model?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, with a Portable Profile when the destination has compatible capabilities. Clone and Remote-Safe Clone require the same model, while Device Snapshot is intended for the exact physical router.

mainEntity.name: Does it work with OpenWrt 22 and OpenWrt 25?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both are active testing targets. Release 17 includes legacy Lua 5.1/LuCI compatibility work and a signed apk package for OpenWrt 25.x firmware.

mainEntity.name: Will a restore change the destination router's IP address?

acceptedAnswer.text: The LuCI restore workflow enables Preserve destination router LAN IP by default, keeping the target's current primary LAN management address unless the option is intentionally disabled.

mainEntity.name: Can I back up custom folders?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Explicit custom files and directories are supported, with recursive directory collection constrained by the tool's existing path, symlink, and size-safety rules.

mainEntity.name: Is it safe to test on my main router?

acceptedAnswer.text: Spare hardware is recommended first. The tool includes validation, pre-restore snapshots, rollback protection, and connectivity safeguards, but real-router testing is intended to uncover firmware-specific behavior.
